def max_sum(arr, n):
    inc = [0] * n
    dec = [0] * n
    inc[0] = arr[0]
    dec[n-1] = arr[n-1]
    for i in range(1, n):
        inc[i] = max(inc[i-1], arr[i])
        dec[n-i-1] = max(dec[n-i], arr[n-i-1])
    max_sum = 0
    for i in range(n):
        max_sum = max(max_sum, inc[i] + dec[i] - arr[i])
    return max_sum
